biography.plain_text: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum is Crown Prince of Dubai, UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence. A son of Dubai's ruler, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid, he became crown prince in 2008 after education in Dubai and at Sandhurst. He also chairs Dubai's Executive Council, overseeing public policy across the emirate.

long_biography.plain_text:
At the 2014 World Equestrian Games in Normandy, Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum and the mare Yamamah led from start to finish to win individual endurance gold. The Dubai Crown Prince thereby became world champion, extending an equestrian practice he had pursued since childhood.

His wider public identity also draws on Emirati cultural traditions. Under the pen name Fazza, Sheikh Hamdan writes Nabati poetry shaped by the language and imagery of desert life. Several poems have become songs, giving his creative work a life beyond the majlis and formal office. In Emirati dialect, Fazza denotes a person who hastens to help and support others.

uncertainties: No dedicated personal Forbes profile was found. Focused exact-name and profile-path searches surfaced Forbes articles that mention Sheikh Hamdan and unrelated Forbes Council profiles, not a personal profile for him.

No reliable public source reviewed isolated a current private asset base, dominant private industry, original wealth-creation sector or present relationship to principal private wealth-producing assets. Those three classifications remain Unknown.

Reuters reported that the Crown Prince owned Zabeel Investments in 2012, while Gulf News described the newly launched company in 2006 as owned by a group of prominent UAE nationals. Reuters also reported that state-owned Dubai Real Estate Corporation took over management. This historical and inconsistent record is not used to classify current private wealth.

Investment Corporation of Dubai identifies itself as the Government of Dubai's principal investment arm and its portfolio as the Government's. Sheikh Hamdan's chairmanship is treated as public stewardship, not personal ownership; state companies, sovereign assets and public budgets are excluded.

Dynastic / royal describes how Sheikh Hamdan gained access to Al Maktoum family standing. It does not assign a private net worth, family assets, public resources, equestrian assets or vessel value to him.

Exact-name searching surfaced references to an unrelated Abu Dhabi figure styled Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Nehayan. The target is the Al Maktoum Crown Prince of Dubai, established by his full patronymic, Dubai roles, official website and Dubawi identity bridge.
The official personal website directly links the proposed LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter and Facebook accounts. It did not expose a personal TikTok link, so no TikTok account is proposed.
No reliable secondary nationality or secondary residence was established. Those blanks remain unchanged.
The Dubai birthplace relies on a WAM-credited contemporaneous report and canonical-profile corroboration rather than an explicit birthplace statement on the current official biography.

The existing biography was not used as evidence. It contains a grammatical error and compresses several sporting achievements into a vague claim about many world titles; the schema-v7 biography pair is independently drafted for review.

Dubawi was used only to bridge the cohort record to the resolved public identity. No vessel, ownership history, dimensions or value estimate informed the wealth classifications or published biographies.
